info.title: agentic-roslyn-tool
info.description: Splits C# files that declare more than one top-level type into one file per type, so a codebase can turn on StyleCop SA1402. Roslyn Syntax API only, so it does not need a solution that compiles.

commands.name: split-types
commands.description: Split C# files that declare more than one top-level type (SA1402).

options.name: --input
options.description:
A directory to scan, one .cs file, a CSV with a 'file' column,
a text file with one path per line, or '-' to read paths from stdin.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description: Repository root used for git operations. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --manifest
options.description:
Path to the manifest CSV. Defaults to sa1402-split-manifest.csv beside a list
input, or in --repo-root for a directory or stdin input.

options.name: --phase
options.description: Which phase to run. Defaults to content.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Shorthand for --phase plan. Cannot be combined with --phase.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print one JSON report to stdout instead of CSV.

options.name: --require-header
options.description: Require and prepend this file header. Off by default.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Skip inputs whose path contains this substring. Repeatable.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help.
Exit codes: 0 no failures, 1 a file failed, 2 bad command line, 3 the run could not complete.
Standard output carries the data (CSV or JSON); a one-line summary goes to standard error.
